title: Design-Build Repair Storm Sewer Lines at U.S. Coast Guard Base San Juan, Puerto Rico Project Number: PN 15852459
description: Design-Build Repair Storm Sewer Lines at U.S. Coast Guard Base San Juan, Puerto Rico Project Number: PN 15852459 The United States Coast Guard anticipates issuing an Invitation for Bids (IFB) for design-build construction services for the Repair Storm Sewer Lines at U.S. Coast Guard Base San Juan, Puerto Rico, PN 15852459. This acquisition will be issued as a total Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) set-aside. The Government intends to award a firm-fixed-price design-build construction contract to the responsible SDVOSB bidder whose bid conforms to the solicitation requirements and is determined to be the lowest-priced responsive bid, subject to a responsibility determination. Project Description The contractor shall provide all labor, supervision, materials, equipment, transportation, design, permits, testing, and incidentals necessary to perform design-build services for the repair of storm sewer lines at U.S. Coast Guard Base San Juan, Puerto Rico. Work shall be performed in accordance with the solicitation specifications and Government-accepted contractor-originated drawings. The anticipated scope of work includes, but is not limited to: Reviewing the Storm Water Master Plan (SWMP) for U.S. Coast Guard Sector San Juan, prepared in December 2013 by URS Infrastructure and Environmental. Verifying the horizontal and vertical locations of affected utilities. Inspecting accessible existing conditions to field-verify the condition, status, and orientation of existing structures and utilities. Determining the potential generation of hazardous waste associated with the work and collecting material samples, as necessary, to determine chemical composition and properties. Preparing and submitting design drawings, specifications, construction schedule, and phasing plan for Government review and site coordination. Following Government acceptance of the design, repairing storm sewer lines, including removal of sediment from storm sewer inlets, catch basins, culverts, and pipes. Performing all associated demolition, disposal, restoration, testing, closeout, and incidental work required to provide a complete and operational project. The complete scope of work, specifications, drawings, bid schedule, site-visit information, contract clauses, and bid-submission instructions will be included in the forthcoming IFB. Acquisition Information Item Information Project Title Design-Build Repair Storm Sewer Lines at U.S. Coast Guard Base San Juan, Puerto Rico PN 15852459 Procurement Method Invitation for Bids (IFB) Set-Aside Total SDVOSB Set-Aside Contract Type Firm-Fixed-Price Design-Build Construction Contract NAICS Code 237110, Water and Sewer Line and Related Structures Construction SB Size Standard $45 million average annual receipts Estimated Magnitude Between $1,000,000 and $5,000,000 Performance Period 290 calendar days, including design and construction Bonding Bid bond, payment bond, and performance bond are required SDVOSB Eligibility To be eligible for award, a bidder must be a small business concern under NAICS code 237110 and meet all applicable SDVOSB eligibility requirements at the time of bid submission and award. Prospective bidders are responsible for ensuring their registration in the System for Award Management is active and that their SDVOSB certification/status is current and accurately reflected in the applicable SBA and SAM systems. The IFB will include the applicable SDVOSB set-aside provisions and clauses, including FAR 52.219-27, Notice of Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business Set-Aside, as applicable. Anticipated Schedule The following dates are estimates and are subject to change: Milestone Anticipated Date Solicitation Issuance October 2026 Bid Opening November 2026 Contract Completion Date September 2027 SAM Registration Prospective bidders must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at SAM.gov, as required by applicable regulations, at the time of bid submission and throughout contract performance. The Coast Guard will post the IFB, amendments, and any related procurement notices through SAM.gov. Interested parties are responsible for monitoring SAM.gov for the solicitation release and all subsequent amendments. Notice to Interested Parties This pre-solicitation notice is issued for informational and planning purposes only. It does not constitute an IFB, request for bids, or commitment by the Government to award a contract. The Government will not accept bids in response to this notice. Interested parties shall not submit bid packages until the IFB is posted on SAM.gov. The IFB will provide the solicitation number, complete bid-submission instructions, bid-opening date and time, bid guarantee requirements, site-visit information, and all applicable terms and conditions. description: COMBINED SYNOPSIS/SOLICITATION TEMPLATE (FAR 12.603) General Information This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial products or services prepared in accordance with the format in subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. Description of Services: The Department of Interior (BOR) require delivery date for an automated vehicular main entrance at the Pleasant Grove Office (PGMB)�capable of reliably controlling entry and exit and fully securing the existing driveway/entrance. Installation, testing, commissioning, and training shall be performed by the contractor at the Government�s destination. Statement of Objectives (SOO) 1. Purpose The purpose of this requirement is to provide an automated vehicular main entrance at the Pleasant Grove Office (PGMB) that reliably controls entry and exit and fully closes the existing driveway/entrance. The objective is to install a gate solution that integrates with the site's existing access-control infrastructure; card/badge readers and exit loop/coil, supports safe daily operations, and improves security. In addition to providing AHJ-approved emergency responder access at the new automated main entrance gate, the contractor shall standardize emergency responder access across the site by retrofitting two existing automated access gates with Authority Having Jurisdiction (AHJ)-approved emergency access key switches or equivalent devices. Each emergency access device shall be integrated with the respective gate operator control circuit to provide immediate emergency opening without replacement of Government access-control components and without defeating required gate safety functions. 2. Background The mission of the Bureau of Reclamation is to manage, develop, and protect water and related resources in an environmentally and economically sound manner in the interest of the American public. The mission of the Provo Area Office is to carry out this mission by supporting safe, reliable facility operations and daily activities at PGMB. This acquisition will deliver a complete gate solution that integrates with existing site infrastructure, including an existing electrical power source near the main entrance, installed card and badge readers for credentialed entry, and an existing loop/coil sensor that allows motor vehicles to exit the facility, and will standardize emergency responder access across all automated vehicular gates at PGMB. The main vehicular entrance is approximately forty feet (40 feet) wide. For planning purposes, the Government anticipates that approximately twenty-five feet (25 feet) of the entrance will be served by an automated vehicular gate, with approximately fifteen feet (15 feet) of chain-link infill tying into the existing fence line to close the remaining portion. These dimensions are approximate. Offerors shall verify field dimensions and site conditions and may propose the final gate configuration necessary to achieve the required security, access-control, safety, aesthetic, and operational outcomes. The current main entrance configuration has two individual gate leaves that are twenty feet (20 feet) each. To improve security and daily operations, the Government seeks a secure, access-controlled solution that closes the entrance and blends seamlessly with the existing chain-link fencing. For purposes of this requirement, security means controlling vehicular and personnel access to the facility, restricting unauthorized entry under normal operating conditions, maintaining reliable closure of the entrance, and integrating with the existing access control system. Existing Conditions and Key Constraints: � Aesthetic Continuity: Maintaining a clean, durable chain-link aesthetic that matches the existing fence visual continuity in pattern, alignment, and finish is required. � Height Matching: Matching the existing fence height at the tie-in location. � Access Integration: Integrating the new gate operator with the existing entry and exit access control system. � Safety and Reliability: Providing safe, reliable automation with entrapment protection, manual release, and commissioning proper operation. � Site Disruption: Minimize impact to staff, visitors, and ongoing site activities during installation. � Environmental Design: Designing the assembly for local wind and snow conditions. � Sustainability and Warranty: Provide maintainable equipment, warranty coverage, and Operations and Maintenance manuals. 3. Scope Offerors shall propose and furnish a complete entrance gate solution for the Bureau of Reclamation�s PGMB that achieves the outcomes identified in Section 4.0. The scope includes the overall management and integration of the work necessary to deliver a secure, access-controlled, automated entrance. Offerors will define their means and methods in their proposed Performance Work Statement. The solution shall close the existing entrance, which is approximately forty feet (40 feet) wide, using an automated vehicular gate solution serving approximately twenty-five feet (25 feet) of the entrance together with approximately fifteen feet (15 feet) of chain-link infill tying into the existing fence line, subject to field verification. Offerors shall determine the final dimensions, configuration, and means and methods necessary to achieve complete entrance closure. Integrate with the site's existing card and badge readers for credentialed entry and with the existing exit loop or coil sensor for automatic egress. Utilize the existing electrical power source, subject to field verification of voltage, circuit capacity, and suitability. Maintain a clean, durable chain-link aesthetic that matches or complements the existing fence and height; and support reliable daily operations under local wind and snow conditions while minimizing disruption during installation. The work shall include dismantling and removal of the existing main entrance gate leaves and associated hardware as required to install the new system. All removed gate materials shall be lawfully disposed of offsite. Existing fence, access-control components, utilities, and other features designated to remain shall be protected from damage. The new automated entrance gate shall include an AHJ-approved means of emergency responder access integrated with its gate operator. In addition, the contractor shall retrofit two existing automated access gates at PGMB with AHJ-approved emergency access key switches or equivalent devices. The emergency access work shall include all required interface components, wiring, conduit, labeling, enclosures, and mounting hardware. Each device shall be integrated directly with the respective gate operator control circuit to allow immediate opening by emergency responders while maintaining applicable UL 325 safety requirements. The contractor shall coordinate device type, mounting location, and installation details with the Fire Code Official and obtain all required approvals prior to installation. title: SHI Replace Lead Glazed Bathtubs at United States Coast Guard Rio Bayamon Housing Base San Juan, Puerto Rico PNUM 24658602
description: Pre-Solicitation Notice SHI Replace Lead Glazed Bathtubs at U.S. Coast Guard Rio Bayamon Housing Base, San Juan, Puerto Rico PNUM: 24658602 The United States Coast Guard anticipates issuing an Invitation for Bids (IFB) for the project identified below. This acquisition will be issued as a total Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) set-aside. The Government intends to award a firm-fixed-price design-build construction contract to the responsible SDVOSB bidder whose bid conforms to the solicitation requirements and is determined to be the lowest-priced responsive bid, subject to a responsibility determination. Project Description The contractor shall provide all labor, materials, equipment, supervision, design, permits, and incidentals necessary to perform design-build services for the replacement of lead-glazed bathtubs at the United States Coast Guard Rio Bayamon Housing Base, San Juan, Puerto Rico. The anticipated scope of work includes, but is not limited to: Conducting pre-construction asbestos-containing materials and lead-based paint surveys and testing for all materials affected by the work. Removing and replacing approximately 120 existing lead-glazed bathtubs. Furnishing and installing new lead-free, steel-glazed bathtubs and properly securing the tubs to adjacent walls. Upon completion of work, provide required certifications and documentation demonstrating that affected work areas are clear of asbestos-containing materials and lead-based paint, as applicable. Performing all associated demolition, disposal, repair, restoration, testing, and closeout activities necessary for a complete and usable installation. The detailed scope of work, specifications, drawings, bid schedule, contract clauses, and submission instructions will be provided in the forthcoming IFB. Acquisition Information Item Information Project Title: SHI Replace Lead Glazed Bathtubs at U.S. Coast Guard Rio Bayamon Housing Base, San Juan, Puerto Rico PNUM 24658602 Procurement Method: Invitation for Bids (IFB) Set-Aside: Total SDVOSB Set-Aside NAICS Code: 236220, Commercial and Institutional Building Construction SB Size Standard: $25 million average annual receipts Estimated Magnitude: Between $1,000,000 and $5,000,000 Contract Type: Firm-Fixed-Price Construction Contract Performance Period: Anticipated to be 240 calendar days Bonds: Bid, Payment,a nd Performance bond will be required Anticipated Schedule The following dates are estimates and are subject to change: Milestone Anticipated Date IFB Issuance: November 2026 Bid Opening: December 2026 Contract Completion Date: August 2027 SDVOSB Eligibility To be eligible for award, the bidder must be a small business concern under the applicable NAICS code and must meet all SDVOSB eligibility requirements identified in the solicitation. Offerors are responsible for ensuring that their SAM.gov registration and applicable SBA SDVOSB/VetCert status, if required, are current and accurate at the time of bid submission and award. The forthcoming solicitation will include the applicable provisions and clauses for a total SDVOSB set-aside, including FAR 52.219-27, Notice of Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business Set-Aside, as applicable. System for Award Management Prospective bidders must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at the time of bid submission and throughout contract performance, as required by applicable regulations. Registration is available at SAM.gov. The U.S. Coast Guard will post the IFB, amendments, and any related procurement notices through SAM.gov. Interested parties are responsible for monitoring SAM.gov for the release of the solicitation and all subsequent amendments. Notice to Interested Parties This pre-solicitation notice is issued for informational and planning purposes only. It does not constitute an IFB, a request for bids, or a commitment by the Government to award a contract. The Government will not accept bids in response to this notice. Interested parties should not submit bid packages until the IFB is released through SAM.gov. Once issued, the IFB will provide the solicitation number, complete submission instructions, bid-opening date and time, site-visit information, bonding requirements, and all other applicable terms and conditions. All correspondence concerning this anticipated requirement should reference: PRESOLICITATION: SHI Replace Lead Glazed Bathtubs at U.S. Coast Guard Rio Bayamon Housing Base, San Juan, Puerto Rico, PNUM 24658602.

title: Commercial Solutions Opening for Joint All-Domain Command and Control (JADC2)
description: Amendment 01 dated 12 July 2021: Updated "CSO" to read "Commercial Solutions Opening" in an effort to prevent confusion with other acronyms. Federal Agency: Air Force Program Office: AFLCMC/XA �Architecture and Integration Directorate� CSO Title: JADC2 Commercial Solutions Opening CSO Type: Commercial Solutions Opening with Calls CSO Number: FA8612-21-S-C001 CSO Date: June 28, 2021 NOTE This is only an announcement; PLEASE DO NOT SUBMIT PROPOSALS IN RESPONSE. Subsequent calls will be issued under this announcement to solicit proposals for specific efforts. Please refer to the attachment section of this announcement for the calls. Publication of this announcement does not obligate the DoD to review any white papers submission beyond an initial administrative review, or to award any specific project, or to obligate any available funds. 1.0 OVERVIEW This Commercial Solutions Opening is intended to be as streamlined as possible to allow the Architecture and Integration Directorate (AFLCMC/XA), or any organization AFLCMC/XA supports, to leverage the latest technology advances from a large variety of prospective Contractors. AFLCMC/XA invites innovative technical approach proposals addressing Joint All-Domain Command and Control (JADC2) problems associated with getting the right information to the right platform/decision maker in the most efficient manner thereby reducing kill chain and Observe, Orient, Decide and Act (OODA) timelines and cycles. This Commercial Solutions Opening will focus on existing and emerging technologies and platforms across the Defense Department, the Intelligence Community, and the commercial world, to perform an integrated analysis of the capability of various options to contribute to the fight and prioritize investments over time. This solicitation is not requesting any white papers or proposals at this time. This Commercial Solutions Opening functions as the overarching umbrella solicitation from which Calls will be published. This Commercial Solutions Opening will remain open for Calls until rescinded. This Commercial Solutions Opening can result in the award of FAR Part 12 Contracts, Procurement for experimental purposes under 10 U.S.C. 4023 or Other Transaction Agreements (OTAs) under 10 USC 4021. Over the course of this time period, AFLCMC/XA will publish Calls via amendments to this Commercial Solutions Opening. These Calls will contain specific Areas of Interest (AoIs) related to JADC2�s Technology Focus Areas. Those specific AoIs are what prospective Contractors shall focus their solutions towards. This is a competitive solicitation that seeks to fund innovative technologies that propose new solutions to expand Air Force capabilities as it relates to JADC2 Technology Focus Areas. AFLCMC/XA is interested in receiving responses from all interested offerors to include, but not limited to, the following: traditional defense contractors, nontraditional defense contractors, large businesses, small businesses and research institutions. The Commercial Solutions Opening is a streamlined acquisition process that seeks to reduce acquisition timelines and acquire new, innovative solutions that companies can bring forth to meet the stated AoIs detailed in each Call. All details of the process shall be governed by this Commercial Solutions Opening unless otherwise noted or expanded upon in each Call. AFLCMC/XA is not obligated to make any awards as a result of this Commercial Solutions Opening and all awards are subject to the availability of funds and successful negotiations. The Government is not responsible for any monies expended by the proposer prior to the issuance of any contract award. AFLCMC/XA reserves the right to modify the solicitation requirements of this Commercial Solutions Opening and each subsequent Call. The Commercial Solutions Opening authority reference to Class Deviation 2022-O0007. 2.0 Commercial Solutions Opening with Calls This Commercial Solutions Opening is a hybrid solicitation against which both Closed Calls and/or Open Period Calls can be published via amendments to the Commercial Solutions Opening. All Calls issued under this Commercial Solutions Opening will include specific instructions including dates, AoIs, evaluation criteria and proposal instructions to potential offerors. While each offeror shall adhere to this Commercial Solutions Opening, the Calls can contain other information the Contractor shall adhere to. Each Call will be announced on the Government Point of Entry (beta.SAM.gov), which may result in the award of a FAR Part 12, Procurement for experimental purposes under 10 U.S.C. 4023 contract or an Other Transaction Agreement (OTA) under 10 USC 4021. 2.1 Closed Calls (One-Step or Two-Step) Over the period of this Commercial Solutions Opening, Calls may be issued to request white papers and/or proposals for specific AoIs. It will be determined on a Call-by-Call basis whether or not the announcement is for a one-step (Proposals only) or a two-step process (White Papers first, then Proposals by invite-only). The submission for white papers and proposals shall be submitted at a specific date and time as set forth in each particular Call. White papers and/or proposals will not be reviewed if submitted after the stated date and time. No exceptions will be made for late proposal submission, including technology issues encountered during submission. One-Step Calls Step 1: Proposal due date and time will be provided in Calls issued against this Commercial Solutions Opening. Two-Step Calls Step 1: White Paper due date and time will be provided in Calls issued against this Commercial Solutions Opening Step 2: Proposal due date and time will be provided in Requests for Proposals (RFPs) sent to offerors that submit White Papers who are evaluated well in accordance with the criteria stated in each Call. 2.2 Open Period Calls (Two-Step) This Commercial Solutions Opening may also have Open Period Calls. Open Period Calls will only be issued under a two-step process. After an Open Call is published, white papers may be submitted at any time during an Open Period for the AoIs detailed in the Call. It is important to note that only white papers submitted in response to the specific AoIs detailed in the Call will be considered. Step 1: White paper submission period will be provided in Calls issued under this Commercial Solutions Opening. Step 2: Proposal due date and time will be provided in Requests for Proposals (RFPs) sent to offerors that submit White Papers who are evaluated well in accordance with the criteria stated in each Call. 3.0 TECHNOLOGY FOCUS AREAS (TFAs) Each Technology Focus Area identifies an area where prospective Contractors can bring substantial value to meet the JADC2 mission. This Commercial Solutions Opening is not limited to the following TFAs. Additional TFAs may be included via amendments to this Commercial Solutions Opening. Digital Architecture, Standards and Concepts This category consists of various activities to analyze, mature, and document the foundational aspects of the development of the overall enterprise architecture. This includes digital modeling, simulation and analysis, trade studies, government owned standard development and maintenance, and potential concept development and refinement. Development of digital engineering architecture to include appropriate toolsets, licenses, data, etc., at multiple levels of security and including services such as data management, configuration control, and security/access management. Other activities may include architecting the toolchains to support the linkage of digital engineering artifacts to modeling and simulation tools and operational analysis. Sensor Integration The development, maturation, integration, demonstration, and proliferation of sensor hardware and software. title: Italy – Data-processing services – Procedura aperta sopra soglia comunitaria, ai sensi dell'art. 71 del d.lgs. n. 36/2023 , articolata un unico lotto, per l'affidamento dei servizi per la rendicontazione delle opere musicali e dei supporti fonografici utilizzati nei programmi trasmessi da Rai.
description: I servizi oggetto di appalto consistono nel riconoscimento, identificazione, completamento informativo e rendicontazione delle Opere Musicali e dei relativi Supporti discografici utilizzati nei programmi radiotelevisivi e nelle trasmissioni radiofoniche Rai, mediante l'utilizzo di sistemi automatici di riconoscimento, banche dati specialistiche e attività di validazione e controllo, al fine di consentire il corretto adempimento degli obblighi previsti dalla normativa applicabile e dagli accordi di licenza nei confronti delle Collecting. Nell'ambito del servizio il Fornitore dovrà, tra l'altro: • acquisire e monitorare i flussi audio/video e i dati necessari alla rendicontazione; • riconoscere e identificare le Opere Musicali e i relativi Supporti mediante sistemi automatici di riconoscimento e le ulteriori metodologie previste dal Capitolato Tecnico; • completare, verificare e aggiornare i metadati necessari alla rendicontazione; • predisporre, trasmettere e rettificare i Cue Sheet secondo il tracciato previsto; • gestire la Black List, i File Scarti e le attività di bonifica e correzione; • produrre la reportistica e le evidenze richieste da Rai ai fini delle verifiche e dei controlli. I servizi comprendono altresì le attività di avvio, messa a regime, supporto operativo e transizione in uscita necessarie a garantire la continuità e la corretta esecuzione del processo di rendicontazione. Rai si riserva la facoltà di richiedere, in tutto o in parte, i seguenti servizi “a richiesta”: a) rendicontazione delle Opere Musicali e dei Supporti relativi alla programmazione dei canali attualmente contraddistinti dal marchio "Rai Italia"; b) riconoscimento e rendicontazione delle Opere Musicali e dei Supporti relativi a contenuti presenti sulla piattaforma "RaiPlay"; c) riconoscimento e rendicontazione delle Opere Musicali e dei Supporti relativi a contenuti presenti sulla piattaforma "RaiPlay Sound"; d) riconoscimento e rendicontazione delle Opere Musicali e dei Supporti relativi a programmi già trasmessi in periodi antecedenti la durata contrattuale sui canali generalisti televisivi e radiofonici. In tali casi Rai metterà a disposizione del Fornitore la possibilità di ascoltare e/o visionare le relative registrazioni; e) riconoscimento e rendicontazione delle Opere Musicali e dei Supporti relativi a programmi già trasmessi in periodi antecedenti la durata contrattuale sui canali tematici, regionali e dedicati alle minoranze linguistiche televisivi e radiofonici. In tali casi Rai metterà a disposizione del Fornitore la possibilità di ascoltare e/o visionare le relative registrazioni; f) elaborazioni e analisi relative alla rappresentatività delle Collecting con riferimento a specifici canali, palinsesti e/o periodi temporali; g) segmentazione della programmazione televisiva ai fini dell'individuazione dell'effettivo orario di messa in onda dei programmi; h) segmentazione della programmazione radiofonica ai fini dell'individuazione dell'effettivo orario di messa in onda dei programmi; i) completamento e integrazione dei dati Rai relativi alle Dichiarazioni Contenuti Programmi (DCP); j) integrazione e riconciliazione dei dati rilevati dal Fornitore con le informazioni relative agli utilizzi musicali contenute nelle Dichiarazioni Contenuti Programmi (DCP) predisposte da Rai. Per la dettagliata descrizione delle caratteristiche tecniche e funzionali dei servizi in oggetto, nonché delle modalità di esecuzione degli stessi si rimanda al Capitolato Tecnico di gara. - ai sensi dell’art. 58 del Codice ed in applicazione dei principi in materia, la procedura è articolata in un unico lotto per le seguenti motivazioni: (i) le prestazioni oggetto dell'affidamento costituiscono un processo unitario e fortemente integrato di riconoscimento, identificazione, completamento informativo e rendicontazione delle Opere Musicali e dei relativi dati fonografici, che richiede la gestione unitaria e omogenea di una medesima Banca Dati al fine di garantire coerenza, univocità e uniformità dei risultati della rendicontazione; (ii) l'esecuzione delle prestazioni presuppone l'utilizzo di un'unica metodologia operativa, di un unico sistema di riconoscimento e di un'unica integrazione applicativa tra i sistemi del Fornitore e quelli della Committente, nonché la gestione coordinata dei Cue Sheet, della Black List, degli Scarti e delle Rettifiche, attività che presentano un elevato grado di interdipendenza tecnica ed operativa; (iii) l'eventuale suddivisione in lotti comporterebbe la necessità di coordinare operatori economici diversi, potenzialmente dotati di differenti banche dati, sistemi di riconoscimento, criteri di classificazione e processi di aggiornamento, con conseguente rischio di disallineamenti informativi, duplicazioni di attività, inefficienze operative e incremento dei costi di coordinamento e controllo; (iv) la gestione unitaria del servizio consente inoltre di perseguire obiettivi di efficienza organizzativa ed economicità dell'azione contrattuale, evitando la frammentazione delle responsabilità e garantendo un presidio omogeneo dell'intero processo di rendicontazione.

title: Germany – Canal construction – Stadt Königswinter – Beseitigung Bahnübergang Drachenfelsstraße - Entwässerungsarbeiten für Rampenanlage mit Bau eines Stauraumkanals mit Pumpstation
description: In der Stadt Königswinter befindet sich der beliebte Ausflugsberg Drachenfels. Dazu kommen die Besucher meist mit dem Schiff über den Rhein bis nach Königswinter und gehen dann auf direktem Weg über die Drachenfelsstraße und dem Bahnübergang (BÜ) „Drachenfelsstraße“ hoch zum Drachenfels bzw. zur Talstation der Drachenfelsbahn (bergseitig). Dabei werden neben der Bundesstraße B 42 auch die Eisenbahnstrecke 2324 von Mülheim (Ruhr)-Speldorf nach Niederlahnstein in Bahn-km 99.127 und 99.212 über den Bahnübergang (BÜ) gequert. Die Strecke 2324 ist mit über 300 Zugfahrten die am meisten belastete Eisenbahnstrecke in Deutschland. Da seit Frühjahr 2026 ein neues Eisenbahnüberführungsbauwerk (als Unterführung - EÜ) als Ersatz für den vorhandenen BÜ hergestellt wird, sind für das geplante, bergseitige Aufgangsbauwerk (Rampen- und Treppenanlage) vorab die vorbereitenden Kanalbaumaßnahmen durchzuführen. Vorliegend werden die Arbeiten zur Entwässerung / Kanalbau ausgeschrieben. Die herzustellenden Kanalanlagen befinden sich zwischen der Unterführung der Bahntrasse und dem Aufgangsbauwerk hangseits zwischen Tunnelausgang und den Straßen Winzerstraße und Drachenfelsstraße.

title: Bulgaria – Construction work for airports – ИЗПЪЛНЕНИЕ НА СТРОИТЕЛНО-МОНТАЖНИ РАБОТИ НА ОБЕКТ „1450/ПИР – ПРОЕКТИРАНЕ И РЕМОНТ НА ПЪТЕКИ ЗА РУЛИРАНЕ И МЕСТОСТОЯНКИ ВЪВ ВОЕННО ФОРМИРОВАНИЕ 26030 - БЕЗМЕР“
description: Предметът на настоящата обществена поръчка е изпълнение на строително-монтажни работи на обект „1450/ПиР – Проектиране и ремонт на пътеки за рулиране и местостоянки във военно формирование 26030 - Безмер“, включително изготвяне на екзекутивната документация след изпълнението на обекта. Ремонтът на пътеките за рулиране и местотстоянката, следва да осигури изпълнението на изискванията за използване на инфраструктурата на цялото летателно поле от самолет F-16 Blok 70 и носенето на съвместно дежурство по Air Policing със съюзни военновъздушни сили. Изграждането на нов инженерен команден пункт следва да създаде условия за по-голяма оперативност при използване на летището за провеждане на регулярна летателна дейност на националните ВВС и съвместно със съюзни военновъздушни сили. Строително-монтажните работи следва да се извършват в съответствие с изискванията на инвестиционен проект (Приложение № 21) и количествено-стойностната сметка към него (Приложение № 22) от документацията за участие (Документацията). Технически показатели: 1. Подобект 1 "Ремонт на пътеки за рулиране и местостоянки във военно формирование 26 030 - Безмер": Широчината на пътеките за рулиране е 18 м с изключение на пътеката за рулиране (югоизточно от централизирана стоянка), водеща до съществуваща бетонна прощадка, която е с ширина 16 м. Около пътеките за рулиране се предвижда банкет с ширина минимум 6 м, оформени като подравнена уплътнена тревна площ. Ценрализираната стоянка е с обща площ 10 350 кв.м. 2. Подобект 2 "Изграждане на инженерен команден пункт във военно формирование 26 030 - Безмер": Предвидено е изграждане на обслужваща сграда – команден пункт, с три експлоатационни нива, без сутерен. В сградата е предвидено да работят 40 човека персонал. Около сградата на командния център е предвиден тротоар с широчина, равна или по-голяма от 1,50 м. Застроена площ 257,99 кв.м. Разгъната застроена площ 545,81 кв.м. Площ на имота по КККР 4 265 771,00 кв.м. Обектът, предмет на настоящата обществена поръчка отговаря на Втора група, Първа категория съгласно чл. 137, ал. 1, т. 1, буква „а“ от ЗУТ, във връзка с чл. 5, ал. 6, т. 2.1.1 от Правилника за реда за вписване и водене на Централния професионален регистър на строителя и чл. 2, ал. 1, т. 5 от Наредба № 1 от 30.07.2003 г. за номенклатурата на видовете строежи. Строително-монтажните работи следва да се извършват в съответствие с изискванията на инвестиционен проект (Приложение № 21) и количествено-стойностната сметка към него (Приложение № 22) от документацията за участие (Документацията).

title: Bulgaria – Various surface works – „Възстановяване на пътни и тротоарни настилки на територията на град София“, реф. № РРС 26-108
description: „Електроразпределителни мрежи Запад“ ЕАД провежда процедура от вида „договаряне с предварителна покана за участие“ с предмет: „Възстановяване на пътни и тротоарни настилки на територията на град София“, реф. № РРС 26-108. Предметът на обществената поръчка е разделен на 4 (четири) обособени позиции, както следва: Обособена позиция № 1: „Възстановяване на пътни и тротоарни настилки на територията на град София – ОЦ „Север“. Обособена позиция № 1 обхваща територията и ще се изпълнява в следните райони на Столична община: Сердика, Подуяне, Слатина, Кремиковци, Оборище и Надежда. Обособена позиция № 2: „Възстановяване на пътни и тротоарни настилки на територията на град София – ОЦ „Запад“. Обособена позиция № 2 обхваща територията и ще се изпълнява в следните райони на Столична община: Нови Искър, Люлин, Възраждане, Връбница, Банкя, Илинден и Красна поляна. Обособена позиция № 3: „Възстановяване на пътни и тротоарни настилки на територията на град София – ОЦ „Изток“. Обособена позиция № 3 обхваща територията и ще се изпълнява в следните райони на Столична община: Младост, Искър, Панчарево, Изгрев, Средец, Студентски град и на територията на община Самоков (в.з. Ярема и м.Стената). Обособена позиция № 4: „Възстановяване на пътни и тротоарни настилки на територията на град София – ОЦ „Юг“. Обособена позиция № 4 обхваща територията и ще се изпълнява в следните райони на Столична община: Лозенец, Красно село, Триадица, Витоша и Овча купел. Всеки кандидат/участник може да участва за всички обособени позиции (една или повече обособени позиции, до максималния брой обособени позиции по предмета на поръчката). Възложителят не ограничава броя на обособените позиции, които могат да бъдат възложени на един и същ изпълнител. Критерият за възлагане на настоящата обществена поръчка при определяне на икономически най-изгодната оферта е „най-ниска цена”. Класирането на участниците се извършва за всяка обособена позиция поотделно. На първо място по съответната обособена позиция се класира участникът, предложил най-ниска обща цена за изпълнение на поръчката. Договор се сключва с класирания на първо място участник за съответната обособена позиция. Срокът на договора за всяка обособена позиция е 24 (двадесет и четири) месеца, считано от датата, на която е сключен или до достигане на максималната стойност на договора, в зависимост от това, кое от така посочените събития ще настъпи първо по време. Категорията на строежите, попадащи в обхвата на всяка една обособена позиция на настоящата обществена поръчка, са пета категория съгласно чл. 137, ал. 1, т. 5 от Закона за устройство на територията. Част от основните видове строително-монтажни работи (СМР) и обобщени количества за четирите обособени позиции, включват: Разкъртване и възстановяване на тротоарни и базалтови плочи – нови, включително материалите – 2800 м2; Възстановяване на асфалт /задължително заливане на контура с разтопен битум/ – 3200 м2; Възстановяване на бетонни настилки – 440 м2; Ремонт на двойна шахта с р-ри 140/100/90 см – 180 бр.; Направа на тройна шахта с р-ри 210/100/90 см – 56 бр.; Възстановяване на паважни настилки – 220 м2; Възстановяване на бордюри със стари – 200 м; Двукратно боядисване по метални повърхности – 200 м2; Изработка и монтаж на армировка с обикновенна и средна сложност от 6÷12 мм. от А1 и А2 – 1440 кг.; Доставка и полагане на бетон Б 20 – 80 м3. Монтаж на метална конструкция – 520 кг; Възстановяване на мазилката около главно електромерно табло (ГЕТ) във вход – 120 м2; Двукратно боядисване на стени около ГЕТ във вход – 120 м2 и други видове СМР, които подробно са описани в количествената сметка за съответната обособена позиция, приложена към Техническите спецификации и изисквания на Възложителя, съответно в количествено-стойностната сметка за съответната обособена позиция, приложена към ценовото предложение от документацията за обществената поръчка. Изпълнението на договора за всяка обособена позиция ще се извършва в зависимост от техническата готовност на Възложителя за възлагане на изпълнението. За възлагане на конкретните видове работи Възложителят съставя документ за възлагане на изпълнението, съдържащ най-малко следната информация: видовете работи и количеството им, срок за изпълнение, цената на база единичните цени и друга информация, необходима за изпълнение на видовете дейности. Документът за възлагане на изпълнението се подписва от Възложителя и Изпълнителя, по ред и начин, описани в проекта на договор. Приемането на изпълнената работа по всеки документ за възлагане на изпълнението се извършва с приемателен протокол, подписан от двете страни по договора, по ред и начин, описани в проекта на договор.

title: Germany – Central-heating installation work – Sanierung Baulich-Technische Infrastruktur: Wärmeversorungsanalge
description: Die Generalverwaltung des Max Planck Institutes in München soll im laufenden Betrieb umfänglich saniert werden. Inhalt der gemäß Leistungsverzeichnis aufgeführten Leistungen ist die Erbringung von Leistungen der Wärmeversorgungsanlagen. Dazu zählen die komplette Erneuerung der Heizungszentrale der Generalverwaltung exklusive der Fernwärmeübergabestation. Diese bleibt wie im Bestand bestehen. Der Rest wird vollständig erneuert. Innerhalb der Zentrale soll dann an den Bestand angeschlossen werden. Die Ausführung kann erst im 3.Bauabschnitt beginnen, da sonst die Auswirkungen auf den Nutzer zu groß wären. Da das Gebäude während der gesamten Arbeiten in Nutzung bleibt, sind alle Tätigkeiten daher mit höchster Sorgfalt sowie unter größtmöglichem Schutz des bestehenden Gebäudes und der vorhandenen Anlagen auszuführen. Um dies umzusetzen läuft das Bauvorhaben in mehreren Bauabschnitten ab. Achtung: Diese Ausschreibung beinhaltet Wartungsleistungen. Ausführungsfristen: Mit der Ausführung ist zu beginnen innerhalb von 12 Werktagen nach Zugang der Aufforderung durch den AG (§5Abs. 2 Satz 2 VOB/B). Die Aufforderung wird Ihnen vorauss. bis zum 29.01.2026 zugehen. Die Leistung ist zu vollenden (abnahmereif fertig zu stellen) innerhalb von 1251 Werktagen nach vorstehend angegebener Frist für den Ausführungsbeginn (5 Arbeitstagen/ Woche) sh. hierzu auch Anlage 1 der Besonderen Vertragsbedingungen VHB-214.. Hinweis betr. Bieterfragen aufgrund besonderer äußerer Ereignisse (z.B. description: Obiectul prezentei proceduri îl reprezintă atribuirea unui contract de concesiune de servicii pentru delegarea gestiunii activităților componente ale Serviciului de Salubrizare privind tratarea mecano-biologică și eliminarea prin depozitare a deșeurilor municipale, în județul Mureș. Activitățile principale ale Contractului sunt: (i) Tratarea mecano-biologică a deșeurilor reziduale; (ii) Transportul deșeurilor stabilizate biologic și al deșeurilor reziduale care nu mai pot fi valorificate la DDN Sânpaul; (iii) Transportul deșeurilor reziduale valorificabile energetic la instalațiile de valorificare energetică; (iv) Eliminarea prin depozitare a deșeurilor reziduale, a deșeurilor stradale, a deșeurilor de pământ și pietre provenite de pe căile publice, a reziduurilor rezultate de la SSCT Cristești, TMB Sânpaul și STZ-uri, precum și a deșeurilor care nu pot fi valorificate provenite din activități de reamenajare și reabilitare interioară și/sau exterioară a locuințelor la Depozitul de Deșeuri Nepericuloase de la Sânpaul. Activitățiile secundare (conexe) ale Contractului sunt: (i) Realizarea proiectului tehnic de execuție pentru construirea Celulei nr. 2 pe amplasamentul DDN Sânpaul; (ii) Realizarea documentației de avizare a lucrărilor de intervenții, inclusiv studii specifice necesare pentru retehnologizarea STMB Sânpaul; (iii) Realizarea proiectului tehnic de execuție pentru retehnologizarea STMB Sânpaul; (iv) Obținerea tuturor avizelor/acordurilor/autorizațiilor necesare pentru autorizarea lucrărilor de construcții și montaj pentru cele două infrastructuri: DDN și STMB; (v) Execuția lucrărilor de construire a Celulei nr. 2 pe amplasamentul DDN Sânpaul; (vi) Furnizarea utilajelor și echipamentelor industriale necesare conform Listelor de investiții (Anexa 3 și Anexa 5 la Caietul de sarcini) inclusiv montajul acestora pe amplasament; (vii) Asistență tehnică din partea echipei/echipelor de proiectare pe tot parcursul realizării investițiilor la cele două infrastructuri; (viii) Închiderea Celulei nr. 1 la epuizarea capacității de depozitare conform Proiectului tehnic de închidere pus la dispoziție în Anexa 6 la Caietul de sarcini; (ix) Închiderea Celulei nr. 2 la epuizarea capacității de depozitare conform Proiectului tehnic de închidere pus la dispoziție de Consiliul Județean Mureș la atingerea capacității de depozitare de 75% în celula nr. 2. Notă: a) termenul până la care operatorii economici pot transmite solicitările de clarificări/informațiile suplimentare cum s-a menționat la Secțiunea I.3 este de 25 zile înanite de data limită de depunere a ofertelor b) termenul limită de răspuns al Autorității Contractante la solicitările de clarificări primite în termenul menționat mai sus este de 15 zile înainte de data limită de depunere a ofertelor.

description: This announcement is a Sources Sought Notice. The purpose of this Sources Sought Notice is to determine interest and capability of potential businesses. The information obtained from this notice is for market research only and will be used to determine the method of procurement including whether to set-aside the requirement for small business or other set-aside programs. REQUIREMENT: The U.S. Coast Guard is looking for sources which would be capable and interested in performing to provide a FIREFIGHTING PROTECTION SYSTEM MAINTENANCE onboard all 418� WMSL national security cutter classes. Responses shall be submitted no later than 06 November at 2:00PM PST. Forward information regarding your Company via email to: Valerie.S.Riverachase@uscg.mil, Contracting Officer, and use as subject line: Sources Sought Response to USCGC FIREFIGHTING PROTECTION SYSTEM MAINTENANCE Submission of Response to Sources Sought Notice: Include the following information: Subject Line: Sources Sought Response for FIREFIGHTING PROTECTION SYSTEM MAINTENANCE FY 27. 1. If claiming HUBZone status, provide a copy of your HUBZONE Certificate from the SBA. If claiming SDVOSBC status, provide documentation that shows the Service-Disabled Veteran (SDV) unconditionally owns 51 % of the business, controls the management and daily operations, and holds the highest officer position in the company. Documentation should also be provided to show that the SDV has a service-connected disability that has been determined by the Department of Defense or Department of War. Finally, provide documentation that shows the business is small under the NAICS code 336611. If claiming VOSBC status, provide documentation that shows the Veteran unconditionally owns 51% of the business, controls the management and daily operation, makes long-term decisions for the business, and holds the highest officer position in the company that works at the business fulltime during normal working hours. The documentation should also show the business is small under the NAICS code 336611. If claiming EDWOSB status, provide documentation that shows the company is at least 51% owned by one or more women who are "economically disadvantaged", and primarily managed by an economically disadvantaged woman that make long-term decisions for the business, hold the highest officer position in the business and work at the business full-time during normal working hours. The documentation should also show the business is small under the NAICS code 336611. A woman is presumed economically disadvantaged if she has a personal net worth of less than $750,000 (with some exclusions), her adjusted gross yearly income averaged over the three years preceding the certification less than $350,000, and the fair market value of all her assets is less than $6 million. description: DISCLAIMER: THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI)/ SOURCES SOUGHT FOR WHITE PAPERS ONLY. THERE IS NO SOLICITATION AT THIS TIME. The Naval Air Systems Command (NAVAIR) is conducting market research to identify potential industry sources and commercial-off-the-shelf (COTS) capabilities. The PMX-201 Precision Strike Weapons, Effects Deployment Office (FXDO), Network Enabled Weapons Trainer (NEWT) Program requests interested parties submit a white paper detailing their proposed approach or existing capability to develop, manufacture, and maintain an airworthy, Aircraft Carrier suitable store[JN1] [CM2] that will emulate all Air launched DOW Network Enabled Weapons (NEW). SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS: Format: White papers must be submitted in PDF/Microsoft Word format. Page Limit: Responses shall not exceed 8 pages, excluding the cover page. Font: Times New Roman or Arial, 11-point font or larger. Deadline: All submissions must be received no later than (NLT) Date will be determined 09 November 2026, 5 pm Eastern Standard Time. All proprietary information contained in the response must be clearly marked. Company business size by NAICS code 4. Small Business Type(s), if applicable 5. Point of Contact for questions and/or clarifications (Name, Title, Phone, Email) 6. Location(s) of work to be performed. Capabilities Statement: � Provide a detailed description of your company's experience, capabilities, and planned approach to develop and manufacture the following: Provide an agnostic Captive Carriage Network Enabled Weapons Trainer (NEWT) to emulate all Network Enabled Weapons (NEWs) employed by aircraft in the DoN inventory. This trainer will have the following: Supportable Platforms The NEWT shall be captive carried from DoN fixed wing platforms that employ Network-Enabled Weapons. The NEWT shall meet exportability requirements to FVEY. Reliability The NEWT shall have a minimum power on time of 4 hrs with a 30 min cool off period for Strike Fighter training, during which the NEWT can be cold soaked at altitude. Maritime Patrol and Reconnaissance Force (MPRF) is 12-hour power-on operations. [JN5] [CM6] This includes power on deck (BIT, Mission Planning download, crypto verification) and power while airborne. BLOS communications are needed pre-employment, employment and post simulated launch of long-range NEWs. Supportability The NEWT shall be capable of off-aircraft BIT/ reprogramming using existing CMBRE or other follow-on systems. The NEWT shall be compatible with existing support equipment and test equipment (GSE). Ground Crew shall be able to change the NEWT to the weapon it is emulating without downloading the NEWT from the aircraft.[JN7] [CM8] The NEWT shall focus on software modularity instead of hardware interchangeability. The NEWT shall not require liquids or gases that need to be refilled. Program Protection The NEWT shall minimize or eliminate weapons CPI content. The NEWT shall meet current AT / Cyber standards for new hardware (if not already flight proven hardware). Environmental/Structural The NEWT shall be designed for the carrier environment. The NEWT shall be designed for a Vmax of 1.2 IMN The NEWT shall be reusable with a maximum down time of 45 minutes between flights. The NEWT life shall maximize the number of catapults and arrestments. Once the NEWT has reached its service life, maintenance actions to return to flying status are limited to the Organizational (O) and Intermediate (I) level maintenance[JN9] [CM10] . Connectivity The NEWT shall utilize all NEW waveforms The NEWT shall be capable of operating between 0-6 GHz including, but not limited to WF L, WF X, WF S, WF Y, and Link-16. The NEWT radio shall be software defined to allow for future waveform growth Hardware The NEWT shall minimize testing requirements to be cleared on the aircraft platform. The NEWT shall be inert with no energetic components The NEWT shall have a clear view of the sky for its own antennas to enter required networks; the NEWT shall not depend on the aircraft platform to communicate with external architecture. The NEWT�s antennas shall be integrated into its Outer Mold Line (OML) and not require deployment of any doors or other mechanisms. The NEWT shall use primary power from the launch platform power source. System Performance The NEWT shall be integrated with the Navy's broader network-centric warfare systems, enabling coordinated operations and enhanced situational awareness. The NEWT shall notify the platform of the receipt and acceptance of Inflight Target Updates (IFTUs).[JN11] [CM12] The NEWT shall exercise the network and weapon mission planning processes to include Cryptographic Key Material handling. The NEWT shall not utilize the onboard processing capacity of the host platform. The NEWT shall be capable of all required processing capabilities with 50% growth available. All processing power will be handled internally to the NEWT. This does not include any processing power the platform will need for cockpit display of IFTU[JN13] [CM14] reception and fly-out. The NEWT shall use the aircraft/weapon interface for the weapon it is emulating (UAI, common flex, 1760, etc) The NEWT shall utilize current Fleet released mission planning system (JMPS/CMPC) as the respective NEW weapon that NEWT is emulating. An emphasis should be placed on minimizing unique planning that deviates from actual weapon mission planning. The NEWT shall be designed for net entry while on the ground, and airborne if NEWT is secured for takeoff. The NEWT shall ingest live, virtual, and constructive tracks from both the continuous learning environment and real-world networks. The NEWT shall emulate the respective dynamic LAR of the weapon that NEWT is emulating. The NEWT shall be designed with future proofing in mind. Future upgrades could involve but not limited to: Open Architecture. Inject new waveforms. Computing power, firmware memory and processor reserve of 50% or greater for future growth. The NEWT shall record data for post flight debrief/analysis including but not limited to: Supply power to the data recorder upon NEWT startup. Enable rapid post flight data extraction via removeable storage or electronic extraction to ensure seamless integration with JMPS / CMPC processing workflows. Maintain open physical and logical access to the memory interface (removeable / electronic) during host aircraft operations with NEWT loaded. Record BLOS IFTUs received and processed Record release conditions at simulated launch. The NEWT shall minimize platform MC code impact. This RFI is issued solely for information and planning purposes�it does not constitute a Request for Proposal (RFP) or a promise to issue an RFP in the future. This request does not commit the U.S. Government to contract for any supply or service whatsoever. Further, the Government is not at this time seeking proposals and will not accept unsolicited proposals. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Quotes are being requested, and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. Solicitation number W9127N27QA002 is issued as a Request for Quote (RFQ), for The US Army Corps of Engineers - Portland District. This is a requirement at The Dalles Lock and Dam to solicit services to test the condition of the Isolated Phase Bus and Duct System and to abate approximately 100 lbs. of gaskets containing asbestos containing material from the isolated phase bus hatch panel doors and dispose of the asbestos material off Government property at approved facilities. This solicitation is advertised as a 100% small business set aside, under NAICS Code: 541380 Testing Laboratories and Services, with a size standard of $19,000,000.00. All prospective offerors must be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) at www.sam.gov to be eligible for award. Lack of SAM registration will make an offeror ineligible for award. buyer: Styrelsen for Grøn Arealomlægning og Vandmiljø
title: EU-udbud af rammeaftale vedrørende kemiske laboratorieanalyser af udvalgte pesticider i grundvand
description: Styrelsen for Grøn Arealomlægning og Vandmiljø udbyder en rammeaftale vedrørende udførelse af kemiske laboratorieanalyser af udvalgte pesticider i grundvand. Der er behov for at udvide NOVANA-overvågningen af pesticider i grundvand med en række udvalgte stoffer. Det præcise omfang er ved at blive afklaret i forbindelse med finanslov 2027 og forventes først endeligt afklaret ultimo 2026. Da prøvetagningen allerede skal opstarte januar 2027, har ordregiver behov for at udbyde aftalen førend de endelige afklaringer omkring økonomi foreligger. På nuværende tidspunkt forventes overvågningen i 2027 som minimum at omfatte analyse for 3 af de 10 udbudte pesticidstoffer. Det forventes, at der som minimum udtages 250 prøver til analyse af de 3 pesticidstoffer. Ordregiver håber at opnå en bevilling, således at analysen kommer til at omfatte alle 10 pesticidstoffer i op til 800 prøver. Da ordregiver ikke forventer at udtage mindre end 250 prøver, evalueres prisen på analyse af alle 10 pesticidstoffer i 250 prøver. Ordregiver har i forvejen to rammeaftaler vedrørende kemisk analyse af miljøfremmede forurenende stoffer i grundvand, hvor den ene omfatter analyse af pesticider. Begge rammeaftaler udløber ultimo 2027. Ordregiver forventer, at eksisterende rammeaftaler, samt rammeaftalen omfattet af dette udbud, bliver udbudt som én samlet rammeaftale i 2028. Der forventes et nyt NOVANA-program i 2028, og da programmet ikke er endeligt fastlagt, udbydes rammeaftalen omfattet af dette udbud alene for år 2027 med mulighed for forlængelse i yderligere ét år, såfremt det kommende NOVANA-program skulle blive forsinket. Prøverne udtages og indleveres på prøveudvekslingsstederne af personale fra ordregivers lokalenheder. Leverandøren skal stå for levering af emballage, afhentning af prøver, transport, analyse og rapportering m.v., som beskrevet i Bilag 1 – Kravspecifikation. Prøveudvekslingsstederne fremgår af Bilag 1.1. Rammeaftalen træder i kraft den 1. januar 2027 og er gældende til den 31. december 2027, med mulighed for forlængelse i yderligere ét år. Rammeaftalens samlede forventede værdi er opgjort til 4 mio. kr. ekskl. moms. Rammeaftalens samlede maksimale værdi er opgjort til 5 mio. kr. ekskl. moms.

title: EU-udbud af rammeaftale vedrørende kemiske laboratorieanalyser af næringsstoffer i marint sediment
description: Styrelsen for Grøn Arealomlægning og Vandmiljø udbyder en rammeaftale vedrørende udførelse af kemiske laboratorieanalyser af næringsstoffer i marint sediment. Næringsstoffer i marint sediment skal overvåges fra 1. januar 2027, idet overvågningen indgår i det nuværende NOVANA-program. Det er endnu ikke afklaret, om det kommende NOVANA-program vil indeholde overvågning af marint sediment. Forventningen er, at det vil indgå, men grundet usikkerheden herom, udbydes opgaven alene for 2027 med mulighed for forlængelse i 3 gange 1 år. De marine sedimentprøver udtages af personale på ordregivers skibe og overleveres til leverandørens kurerer på en række udvalgte prøveudvekslingssteder (havne). Leverandøren skal stå for afhentning af prøver, transport, analyse og rapportering m.v., som beskrevet i Bilag 1 – Kravspecifikation. Prøveudvekslingsstederne fremgår af Bilag 1.1. Rammeaftalen træder i kraft den 1. januar 2027 og er gældende til den 31. december 2027, med mulighed for forlængelse i yderligere 3 gange 1 år. Rammeaftalens samlede forventede værdi er opgjort til 2 mio. kr. ekskl. moms. Rammeaftalens samlede maksimale værdi er opgjort til 2,5 mio. kr. ekskl. moms.

title: Netherlands – Bicycles – EA Bedrijfsfietsen en handhavingsfietsen Gemeente Zwolle
description: De gemeente Zwolle sluit voor deze opdracht per perceel een Raamovereenkomst met één Opdrachtnemer. De Raamovereenkomsten hebben betrekking op de levering van fietsen in eigendom van de gemeente en het bijbehorende onderhoud, reparatie en service. Lease- en huurconstructies maken geen onderdeel uit van deze aanbesteding. De aanbesteding bestaat uit twee afzonderlijk te gunnen percelen: Perceel 1 – Handhavingsfietsen Dit perceel betreft de levering van handhavingsfietsen, waaronder robuuste fietsen zoals mountainbikes en elektrische varianten, die worden ingezet bij de uitvoering van toezicht- en handhavingstaken. Perceel 2 – Bedrijfsfietsen Dit perceel betreft de levering van elektrische en niet-elektrische bedrijfsfietsen. Deze fietsen worden ingezet als functioneel vervoermiddel ter ondersteuning van de dagelijkse werkzaamheden, met name voor korte dienstreizen en verplaatsingen tussen locaties. Omvang Perceel 1 – Handhavingsfietsen De geraamde opdrachtwaarde bedraagt € 156.392, - exclusief btw over de maximale looptijd van vier jaar. Om beperkte volumewijzigingen gedurende de looptijd te kunnen opvangen, wordt voor de reguliere scope een maximale opdrachtwaarde van € 195.490, - exclusief btw gehanteerd. Daarnaast is de volgende herzieningsmogelijkheid voorzien: Uitbreiding handhavingsfietsen: als gevolg van personele wijzigingen, veranderingen in mobiliteitsbeleid of organisatorische verschuivingen kan sprake zijn van uitbreiding met maximaal tien (10) handhavingsfietsen. De maximale financiële omvang van deze uitbreiding bedraagt € 56.000, - exclusief btw, bestaande uit maximaal € 50.000, - voor aanschaf en € 6.000, - voor onderdelen en onderhoud. Daarmee bedraagt de maximale financiële omvang voor Perceel 1 inclusief deze herzieningsmogelijkheid € 251.490, - exclusief btw. Omvang Perceel 2 – Bedrijfsfietsen De geraamde opdrachtwaarde bedraagt € 292.916, - exclusief btw over de maximale looptijd van vier jaar. Om beperkte volumewijzigingen gedurende de looptijd te kunnen opvangen, wordt voor de reguliere scope een maximale opdrachtwaarde van € 366.145, - exclusief btw gehanteerd. Daarnaast zijn de volgende herzieningsmogelijkheden voorzien: Uitbreiding elektrische bedrijfsfietsen: bij vervanging van reguliere bedrijfsfietsen kan gedurende de looptijd worden gekozen voor uitbreiding met maximaal vijftien (15) elektrische bedrijfsfietsen. De maximale financiële omvang hiervan bedraagt € 67.200, - exclusief btw, bestaande uit maximaal € 36.000, - voor aanschaf en € 31.200, - voor onderdelen en onderhoud. Uitbreiding elektrische bedrijfsfietsen in verband met dienstreizen: als gevolg van gewijzigd mobiliteitsbeleid kan voor een groep medewerkers behoefte ontstaan aan aanvullende elektrische fietsen. Hiervoor kan de vloot worden uitgebreid met maximaal twintig (20) elektrische bedrijfsfietsen. De maximale financiële omvang van deze uitbreiding bedraagt € 104.000, - exclusief btw. Daarmee bedraagt de maximale financiële omvang voor Perceel 2 inclusief deze herzieningsmogelijkheden € 537.345, - exclusief btw. De totale maximale financiële omvang van beide percelen gezamenlijk bedraagt daarmee € 788.835, - exclusief btw. De betreffende Raamovereenkomst eindigt uiterlijk na afloop van de maximale contractduur of eerder wanneer de voor het betreffende perceel geldende maximale opdrachtwaarde is bereikt.

buyer: Stadtwerke Verkehrsgesellschaft Frankfurt am Main mbH (VGF)
title: Germany – Job search services – Rahmenvertrag zur Veröffentlichung von Stellenanzeigen der Verkehrsgesellschaft Frankfurt (VGF)
description: Die VGF beauftragt den Auftragnehmer mit der Veröffentlichung von Stellenausschreibungen inklusive der Beratung und dient als Schnittstelle zu Stellenportalen. Im Schnitt veröffentlicht die VGF zweihundert Stellenausschreibungen jährlich, dabei werden in der Regel für jede Stellenausschreibung individuell mehrere Portale parallel gebucht. Zum einen auf gängigen Portalen wie beispielsweise stepstone.de, aber auch aus ausgewählten Fachportalen wie beispielsweise bauningenieur24.de. Die Stellenausschreibungen werden aus dem Multiposting-Modul unserer Bewerbermanagementsoftware im, auf beispielsweise stepstone.de üblichen, „Liquid Design“ bereitgestellt. Je nach Portal sind Anpassung und Gestaltung der Stellenanzeige notwendig, sowie die Rubrizierung und Verschlagwortung der Stellenanzeigen. Wichtig sind eine ganzheitlich digitale Abbildung des Prozesses, von der Übermittlung des Auftrages bis zur digitalen Freigabe, sowie der Zugang zu einer zentralen Zugriffsstatistik in Echtzeit für eine kontinuierliche Performancekontrolle der Stellenanzeigen. Der Auftragnehmer bietet im Bedarfsfall die Möglichkeit kleiner Performance Marketing Kampagnen für einzelne Stellenausschreibungen. Laufzeit über 4 Jahre mit der Option auf Verlängerung um weitere 4 Jahre.

title: Germany – Construction work – Neubau Kita Schwalbennest - Elektroarbeiten
description: Die Gemeinde Schönefeld beabsichtigt die Kita Schwalbennest, Schwalbenweg 8, Schönefeld komplett neu zu errichten. Hier handelt es sich um die Elektroarbeiten. Im Zuge des Neubaus der KITA Schwalbennest wird die Elektroinstallation mit den Kostengruppen 440 und 450 ausgeschrieben. Die elektrische Energieversorgung erfolgt über einem neuen Hausanschluss der E.DIS Netz GmbH. Der Eektroenergiebedarf wird über eine Wandlermessung erfasst. Der neu zu errichtende Gebäude-Hauptverteiler(NSHV) versorgt dabei in dem zweigeschossigen Gebäude jeweils zwei Unterverteilungen pro Etage. Zur Senkung des Elektroenergiebedarfs ist eine PV-Anlage auf dem Flachdach vorgesehen. Im Gebäude ist eine Sicherheitsbeleuchtung der Flucht- und Rettungswege gemäß Brandschutzkonzept vorzusehen. Die Sicherheitsbeleuchtungsanlage wird gemäß DIN VDE 0108-100 und DIN EN 1838 ausgeführt. Die Sicherheitsbeleuchtung wird dabei über eine Einzellbatterieanlage realisiert. Die Erdungsanlage wird gemäß DIN 18014 hergestellt. Eine baurechtlich geforderte Blitzschutzanlage wird gemäß der Blitzschutzklasse III nach DIN VDE 0185-305 errichtet.

title: Germany – Training seminars – Seminare Kommunikation und Konflikte

Ziel der Maßnahmen ist es, die Handlungssicherheit der teilnehmenden Personen in unterschiedlichen Gesprächs- und Konfliktsituationen zu stärken und einen professionellen, wertschätzenden und lösungsorientierten Umgang mit herausfordernden Kommunikationssituationen zu fördern. Die Seminare sollen die Teilnehmer und Teilnehmerinnen dabei unterstützen, ihre kommunikativen Kompetenzen für die vielfältigen Anforderungen ihres beruflichen Alltags weiterzuentwickeln. Beide Seminare sollen unabhängig voneinander besucht werden können. Ziel des Vergabeverfahrens ist es, jeweils pro Los einen Rahmenvertrag mit einer/einem Trainer/in für die Konzeption und Durchführung von Seminaren zu den Themen "Gesprächsführung" (Los 1) sowie "Konfliktmanagement mit Schwerpunkt Deeskalation" (Los 2) abzuschließen.

title: Germany – Architectural, engineering and planning services – Straßen- und Kanalplanungen im Quartier Obere/Untere Schanze
description: Die Stadt Detmold beabsichtigt im Quartier Schanze die Straßen sowie die Schmutz- und Regenwasser-kanalisation zu sanieren/neu zu planen. Ziel ist die Sicherstellung der hydraulischen Leistungsfähigkeit, die bauliche Substanzkalkulation sowie die koordinierte Erschließung neuer Gebiete unter Berücksichtigung der parallel verlaufenden Straßen- und Fernwärmebaumaßnahmen. LOS 1 Objektplanung Verkehrsanlagen und Ingenieurbauwerke Der Planungsauftrag umfasst zum einen die bauliche und hydraulische Sanierung der Regen- und Schmutzwasserkanäle in den Straßen Untere Schanze, Obere Schanze, Amselweg, Amselhöhe und Unter der Jugendherberge in Detmold Hiddesen, gemäß des Abwasserbeseitigungskonzept (ABK) der Stadt Detmold (Ordnungsnummer 01.05.01) und zum anderen die Neuplanung der Straßen. In Teilen ist keine geregelte Regenentwässerung vorhanden, weshalb hier die erstmalige Erschließung herzustellen ist. Im Rahmen der Kanalsanierung des Parkwegs wurde die hydraulische Berechnung und die Dimensionierung eines Teilnetzes durchgeführt. Die Ergebnisse der Dimensionierung werden zur Verfügung gestellt. Des Weiteren sind alle Bestandshaltungen und -schächte, welche nicht auf Grund der Hydraulik erneuert werden, baulich zu bewerten. Für bauliche Mängel sind Sanierungskonzepte zu erarbeiten und mit dem Auftraggeber abzustimmen und umzusetzen. Alle weiteren notwendigen Bewertungen, Berechnungen, Nachweise, Anzeigen und Anträge sind Bestandteil dieses Auftrags. LOS 2 Technische Ausrüstung Das Ziel der Lichtplanung ist eine normgerechte Beleuchtung der Außenanlage nach der DIN EN 13201-1/2 mit der Einhaltung der aktuellen Fassung des BNatSchG. Die Planung bezieht sich nur auf die Leuchte und das Tragsystem. Die Planung der elektrischen Leistung ist nicht Gegenstand des Angebotes. Die Schnittstelle ist die Anschlussklemme im Kabelübergangskasten. Weitere Details entnehmen Sie bitte den Vergabeunterlagen.

title: Germany – Laboratory, optical and precision equipments (excl. glasses) – Programmierbares Windfelderzeugungssystem für einen Wind-Wellen-Kanal
description: Präambel Die Helmholtz-Zentrum hereon GmbH (Hereon) ist eine gemeinnützige Forschungseinrichtung und eine der 18 Mitgliedseinrichtungen der Hermann von Helmholtz-Gemeinschaft Deutscher Forschungszentren e. V. Die Aufwendungen des Hereon werden zu 90% vom Bund (BMFTR - Bundesministerium für Forschung, Technologie und Raumfahrt) und zu 10% von den vier Konsortialländern (Schleswig-Holstein, Hamburg, Niedersachsen und Brandenburg) finanziert. Die satzungsmäßige Aufgabe der Gesellschaft ist es, im multidisziplinären Verbund Forschung und Entwicklung, insbesondere auf den Gebieten der Materialforschung, der Küsten-, Klima- und Umweltforschung sowie der regenerativen Medizin zu betreiben. Gegenstand der Vergabe ist ein Programmierbares Windfelderzeugungssystem für einen Wind-Wellen-Kanal. Technische Spezifikation 1. Beschaffungsumfang Die Beschaffung umfasst die Lieferung, Installation, Inbetriebnahme und Funktionsprüfung eines programmierbaren Windfelderzeugungssystems für den Betrieb über einem bestehenden Wind-Wellen-Kanal. Das System muss sämtliche für den Betrieb erforderlichen mechanischen, elektrischen, steuerungstechnischen und softwareseitigen Komponenten umfassen, einschließlich Tragstrukturen, Strömungskonditionierungselementen, Luftführungen, Steuerungssoftware sowie Kommunikationsinfrastruktur. Das System wird für wissenschaftliche Untersuchungen in folgenden Bereichen eingesetzt: - Wind-Wellen-Interaktion - Atmosphäre-Ozean-Austausch - Grenzschichtprozesse - Meeresgischt- und Aerosolerzeugung - Anwendungen der Offshore-Windenergie - Validierung numerischer Modelle 2. Wissenschaftliche und funktionale Anforderungen Eine zentrale Anforderung dieser Beschaffung ist die Fähigkeit, realistische atmosphärische Anregungsbedingungen über einer Wasseroberfläche zu erzeugen. Im Gegensatz zu herkömmlichen Gebläsesystemen von Windkanälen muss das angebotene System die kontrollierte und reproduzierbare Erzeugung sowohl von: - räumlich nicht-homogenen Windfeldern als auch von - zeitlich veränderlichen Windbedingungen einschließlich Böen ermöglichen. Das System muss daher: 1. aus mindestens 40 unabhängig regelbaren Ventilatormodulen bestehen, die in einem zweidimensionalen Array angeordnet sind; 2. Windgeschwindigkeiten von mindestens 20 m/s ohne nachgeschaltete Strömungsmanipulationseinrichtungen erzeugen können; 3. eine Beschleunigung (Ramp-Up) von mindestens 15 m/s2 ohne nachgeschaltete Strömungsmanipulationseinrichtungen ermöglichen; 4. eine Verzögerung (Ramp-Down) von mindestens 10 m/s2 ohne nachgeschaltete Strömungsmanipulationseinrichtungen ermöglichen; 5. die unabhängige Ansteuerung jedes einzelnen Ventilatormoduls erlauben; 6. beliebige zweidimensionale Windgeschwindigkeitsverteilungen erzeugen können; 7. asymmetrische Windprofile, Windgeschwindigkeitsgradienten von mindestens 7 m/s pro Meter sowie Scherprofile ohne nachgeschaltete Strömungsmanipulationseinrichtungen erzeugen können; 8. zeitlich veränderliche Windbedingungen und benutzerdefinierte Windgeschwindigkeits-Zeitreihen erzeugen können; 9. reproduzierbare Böenereignisse erzeugen können; 10. eine gleichzeitige räumliche und zeitliche Variation des Windfeldes ermöglichen; 11. vordefinierte Windszenarien speichern, reproduzieren und modifizieren können; 12. eine offene Softwareschnittstelle (API) für externe Steuerung, Automatisierung und Synchronisation mit wissenschaftlicher Messtechnik bereitstellen. Die Erzeugung komplexer, räumlich variierender und zeitlich instationärer Windfelder stellt eine wesentliche Anforderung dieser Beschaffung dar. 3. Windgenerierungssystem Das Windgenerierungssystem muss: 1. mindestens 40 individuell regelbare Ventilatormodule umfassen; 2. einen stabilen und reproduzierbaren Betrieb über den gesamten Betriebsbereich gewährleisten; 3. Echtzeitanpassungen der Betriebsparameter ermöglichen; 4. für den kontinuierlichen wissenschaftlichen Betrieb geeignet sein; 5. sämtliche erforderlichen integrierten Elektronikkomponenten, Netzteile, Kommunikationshardware, Verkabelungen und Strukturbauteile enthalten. 4. Steuerungssoftware Die bereitgestellte Software muss folgende Funktionen bieten: 1. eine grafische Benutzeroberfläche zur Bedienung des Systems; 2. individuelle Ventilatorsteuerung; 3. gruppierte Ventilatorsteuerung; 4. Erstellung und Speicherung benutzerdefinierter Windszenarien; 5. Programmierung zeitabhängiger Windfelder; 6. Import und Export von Windprofilen; 7. Skript- und Automatisierungsfunktionen; 8. eine offene API für wissenschaftliche Anwendungen. Die Software muss den Langzeitbetrieb sowie die zukünftige Integration in Laborsteuerungssysteme unterstützen.

title: Germany – Services incidental to forestry – 10024519-Capacity building and support for National Forest Inventory in Indonesia
description: Indonesia"s tropical forests are critical for global climate stability, yet they face widespread threats from unsustainable land-use practices, illegal logging, and forest fires, which cause significant deforestation and high Greenhouse Gas (GHG) emissions. While the Government of Indonesia aims for a 29% carbon emission cut by 2030 and has fostered new policies through decentralization, the key challenge remains implementation at the regional and provincial level. Differences in technical capacity, resource allocation, and inter-sectoral coordination may affect the consistency of monitoring, law enforcement, and sustainable forest management (SFM) planning required to support national commitments. The FORCLIME project aims to achieve two objectives (1) Climate Mitigation: To significantly reduce GHG emissions from the forestry sector and (2) Livelihood Strengthening: To strengthen local livelihoods without undermining conservation efforts. The FORCLIME project collaborates with the Indonesian Ministry of Forestry on national forest policy and sector strategies, as well as on the subnational implementation of activities to support local forest management. At subnational level the project operates in eastern Indonesia in the provinces of Central Sulawesi, Papua, and South West Papua and South Papua. The project directly addresses implementation gaps by building technical capacity and improving cross-sectoral coordination within provincial and national authorities, ensuring the effective execution of forest conservation and SFM policy on the ground. Effective local stakeholder participation is a critical success factor in all planning and strategy development processes.

Darüber hinaus bestehen Defizite bei den Freizeit-, Aufenthalts- und Kommunikationsflächen für die Auszubildenden. Im Rahmen einer Machbarkeitsstudie wurden verschiedene Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten für den Standort untersucht. Auf Grundlage der Ergebnisse hat sich der Auftraggeber für die Realisierung eines Ersatzneubaukonzeptes entschieden. Damit sollen die funktionalen, organisatorischen, pädagogischen und energetischen Anforderungen langfristig erfüllt und gleichzeitig der laufende Schul- und Wohnheimbetrieb während der Realisierung sichergestellt werden.

An der Stahlkonstruktion (Überbau) sind bereits an zahlreichen Stellen Korrosionsschäden erkennbar. Zudem sind mehrere Nieten durchgerostet oder fehlen vollständig. Die festgestellten Schäden sollen im Rahmen der Sanierung instandgesetzt werden. Im Bereich des Unterbaus sind örtlich Betoninstandsetzungsmaßnahmen erforderlich. Darüber hinaus besteht im Bereich des Mauerwerks partieller Instandsetzungsbedarf an den Fugen. Auf Grundlage der Ergebnisse der durchzuführenden Schadensanalyse, der statischen Berechnung des Gesamtbauwerks (gemäß HOAI) sowie der Erstellung und Prüfung der erforderlichen Standsicherheitsnachweise ist ein geeignetes Sanierungskonzept zu erarbeiten. Darüber hinaus ist eine Neuplanung der Verkehrsfläche (Fußbelag) inklusive Geländer vorzu- nehmen. Ziel ist eine nachhaltige Verbesserung der Dauerhaftigkeit und Tragfähigkeit der bestehenden Fuß- und Radwegbrücke.

title: Germany – Fire and explosion protection and control consultancy services – Neubau Bildungscampus Eslohe - Brandschutz
description: Am Bildungsstandort Eslohe befindet sich das zentrale Kompetenzzentrum des Dachdeckerhandwerks in Westfalen. Der Standort vereint die schulische Berufsausbildung, die Unterbringung der Auszubildenden, Verpflegungsangebote sowie Maßnahmen der Aus- und Weiterbildung in einem zusammenhängenden Campus. Die bestehende Gebäudeinfrastruktur stammt überwiegend aus den Jahren 1968 und 1985. Die vorhandenen Gebäude entsprechen sowohl hinsichtlich ihrer funktionalen Struktur als auch in Bezug auf die bauliche, energetische und nutzungsspezifische Qualität nicht mehr den heutigen Anforderungen an einen modernen Bildungs- und Internatsstandort. Insbesondere die bestehende Mischnutzung von Unterricht, Verwaltung, Wohnen und Verpflegung innerhalb der vorhandenen Gebäude führt zu organisatorischen Einschränkungen und erschwert eine zeitgemäße Umsetzung des Bildungsauftrags. Auch die Unterbringungssituation im Wohnheimbereich entspricht nicht mehr den aktuellen Anforderungen. Die derzeit überwiegend vorhandenen Mehrbettzimmer mit Gemeinschaftssanitäranlagen bieten nur eingeschränkte Aufenthalts- und Wohnqualität. Darüber hinaus bestehen Defizite bei den Freizeit-, Aufenthalts- und Kommunikationsflächen für die Auszubildenden. Im Rahmen einer Machbarkeitsstudie wurden verschiedene Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten für den Standort untersucht. Auf Grundlage der Ergebnisse hat sich der Auftraggeber für die Realisierung eines Ersatzneubaukonzeptes entschieden. Damit sollen die funktionalen, organisatorischen, pädagogischen und energetischen Anforderungen langfristig erfüllt und gleichzeitig der laufende Schul- und Wohnheimbetrieb während der Realisierung sichergestellt werden.
